title: Lebanon 'a playground for others': fresh strikes on Beirut trigger concern
summary: Soon after it said it had intercepted Hezbollah rockets late on June 7, Israel struck Beirut's southern suburbs, hitting apartments in two buildings. The attack killed two people and wounded 20 others, according to Lebanese authorities. As FRANCE 24's Antonia Kerrigan reports, the fresh strikes have triggered concern over the escalation .among the Lebanese…
